name: Time Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description:
Welcome to Time Mahjong, a captivating twist on the classic tile-matching game infused with a time-themed challenge. Dive into a world of intricate mahjong puzzles, where every move counts against the ticking clock.

Embark on a journey through beautifully designed levels, each presenting unique tile arrangements and strategic challenges. Race against time to match pairs of tiles and clear the board before the clock runs out.
